scope: A separate material-reference layer for a small, explicitly selected subset; it is not required to publish or consume the native SPH trajectory dataset.

source_evidence.boundary: D03 Q-I/Q-N checks establish numerical integrity/scope only; they do not validate material truth or external science.

core_gate.interpretation: The native fields and D03 numerical/scope audit remain the core product. A missing, failed, partial, or contradictory tracer is retained as a tracer diagnostic and must not invalidate otherwise admissible native data.

intended_use: Compare an independently defined material-reference path with native numerical-particle observables on a small subset.
Quantify tracer coverage, censoring, unresolved lineage, and disagreement without rewriting native labels.
Support later owner-approved material transport analysis outside the current dataset-only core gate.
non_goals: It is not a replacement for native SPH fields.
It is not a training, inference, checkpoint replay, tuning, ranking, or model-qualification input in DS-DATA-01.
It is not a claim that Mk, Type, particle_id, or particle_zone is material identity.
It is not a requirement that every family, resolution, lifecycle, or split have a tracer.

subset_selection_contract.selection_unit: case_id plus a bounded set of tracer_id values and/or an explicit seed/region recipe
subset_selection_contract.default_scope: Prefer a small 3D case with D03 Q-I-structure-pass and Q-N-integrity-pass and an explicit closed or scope-audited lifecycle. This preference is a tracer quality recommendation, not a gate on native data.
subset_selection_contract.subset_size: bounded and declared per case; no global denominator or coverage claim is implied

tracer_storage_contract.container: separate sidecar HDF5/JSON artifact; never silently add tracer arrays to or overwrite the native trajectory file

time.meaning: Tracer sampling times, linked to native time by an explicit mapping or tolerance.

tracer_id.meaning: Independent tracer marker identity within this sidecar.

tracer_position.meaning: Position produced by the independent tracer method when available.

tracer_valid.meaning: Whether the tracer value is available at the time/marker pair. False is censored/unknown until a status code explains it.

tracer_status.meaning: Explicit tracer availability/lineage status, independent of native valid.

recommended_optional_arrays.native_particle_id_at_sample: [T,K] numerical association only; must be paired with native_particle_zone_at_sample
recommended_optional_arrays.association_distance: [T,K] m; distance between tracer position and associated native node when association is defined
recommended_optional_arrays.tracer_mass: [K] or [T,K] kg only when the tracer method defines a mass measure
recommended_optional_arrays.material_class: [K] independent class only when supplied by the tracer setup; never infer from Mk or Type

tracer_storage_contract.association_boundary: A tracer-to-native-particle association is a diagnostic correspondence at a sample, not proof that the native numerical node is the same material parcel.

status_enum.tracked: Tracer value available and method reports a valid track at this sample.
status_enum.not_initialized: Marker was not initialized at this time.
status_enum.out_of_domain: The tracer method explicitly reports leaving its defined domain; this is not automatically a native material exit.
status_enum.censored_by_tracer_failure: The independent tracer failed or became unresolvable; downstream material fate is unknown.
status_enum.unresolved_lineage: The tracer or mapping cannot distinguish competing numerical lineage.
status_enum.zone_transition: The tracer association crossed a numerical resolution zone; retain the event, do not call it material mixing.
status_enum.unknown: No defensible status was established. Never coerce to tracked or no-event.

required_extra_evidence: tracer coverage and terminal status audit
forbidden_outputs: material conservation claim from tracer alone
using tracer success as native-data admission

rules: Do not require tracer active count or mass to remain constant.
Distinguish out_of_domain, inlet/not_initialized, tracer failure, and unknown.
A tracer-derived exit is an optional diagnostic and cannot repair missing native flux accounting.
A native particle_id match is not a material lineage match.
Zone transitions and unresolved split/merge events must be explicit.
If the tracer cannot resolve lineage, use censored_by_tracer_failure or unresolved_lineage, never a confident material destination.
The tracer is calibration/control evidence only.
Do not merge 2D tracer statistics with 3D production statistics.
2D tracer absence or failure cannot block a 3D native dataset and does not create 3D evidence.

status_consistency_rules: tracer_valid=true requires status=tracked unless an explicit method-specific status is registered
tracer_valid=false must not be counted as a tracked no-event
censored_by_tracer_failure and unresolved_lineage are unknown/censored outcomes, not negative outcomes
coverage fractions use the declared tracer subset denominator only
tracer_audit_outputs.q_e_status: not_assessed unless an independent external measurement/ground-truth binding is added later
tracer_audit_outputs.core_gate_impact: always diagnostic_only; never changes native production eligibility

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not make tracer presence a required field in the native HDF5 schema.
Do not use a failed tracer to reject a numerically admissible native case.
Do not treat a tracer success as proof that all native SPH particles have material fidelity.
Do not use Mk, Type, particle_id, particle_zone, or valid as an independent material tracer without a separate method and provenance.
Do not convert tracer censoring into a material no-event or zero mass.
Do not pool open-lifecycle, variable-resolution, 2D calibration, and closed tracer statistics without explicit scope strata.
